title: CarePath Mobile
description: Mobile patient journey experience for distributed care teams.
longDescription: We rebuilt appointment prep, follow-up, and messaging into one mobile workflow that reduced support load and improved completion rates.
challenge: Patients were missing key steps before and after visits, creating rework for care coordinators.
solution: We introduced a guided timeline with reminders, secure messaging, and context-aware checklists.

slides.title: Research
slides.description: Interviewed patients and coordinators to map drop-off points.

slides.title: Experience
slides.description: Designed a step-by-step care timeline and status model.

slides.title: Implementation
slides.description: Delivered secure workflows with audit trails and role-based views.

slides.title: Outcome
slides.description: Scaled to multi-clinic rollout with operational dashboards.
